roles.name: Chief Construction Officer
roles.description: Leads organizational construction strategy, digital BIM transformation, sustainability, and large-scale capital project portfolios.

roles.name: Vice President of Construction
roles.description: Oversees multi-site regional construction operations, resource allocation, and program-level safety and financial targets.

roles.name: Construction Director
roles.description: Directs project delivery timelines, contractor negotiations, quality assurance protocols, and environmental standards.

roles.name: Construction Manager
roles.description: Directs total construction execution from groundbreaking to handover, managing multi-million dollar budgets and subcontractor teams.

roles.name: Project Manager
roles.description: Controls day-to-day project milestones, scope changes, stakeholder communications, and vendor deliverables.

roles.name: Construction Superintendent
roles.description: Leads all on-site field execution, daily crew logistics, site inspection, and subcontractor trade synchronization.

roles.name: General Contractor
roles.description: Coordinates prime contract requirements, procures materials, and leads all specialty trade subcontractors on site.

roles.name: Construction Foreman
roles.description: Directs daily trade tasks, tool safety, field material staging, and productivity for specific trade crews.

roles.name: Estimator
roles.description: Performs quantity takeoffs, cost modeling, labor projections, and competitive tender bid preparations.

roles.name: Scheduler
roles.description: Builds and baselines critical path method (CPM) master schedules and simulates delay scenarios.

roles.name: Site Supervisor
roles.description: Maintains physical site safety compliance, perimeter security, permit verifications, and daily shift logs.

roles.name: Civil Engineer
roles.description: Performs structural, geotechnical, and environmental calculations for foundations, roadways, and superstructure framing.

roles.name: Construction Architect
roles.description: Creates architectural blueprints, spatial layouts, parametric facades, and sustainable building documentation.

roles.name: Skilled Tradesperson
roles.description: Carries out specialized technical installations across electrical, HVAC, smart plumbing, and framing.

roles.name: Equipment Operator
roles.description: Operates telematics-guided excavators, autonomous cranes, bulldozers, and heavy earthmoving machines.

roles.name: Construction Laborer
roles.description: Assists with material distribution, staging, basic assembly, site housekeeping, and support operations.

roles.name: Apprentice
roles.description: Gains structured hands-on trade experience under the mentorship of certified journeypersons and master craftsmen.
